purpose: Select one signed higher-moment price-discovery mechanism after rejecting same-mechanism variance-concentration, sign-run, window, and tail-statistic searches before any new candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_return_variance_entropy_238m: Direction-blind Shannon dispersion of squared-return contributions. Skewness instead keeps the sign of centered returns and measures third-moment asymmetry, not variance breadth.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_upside_semivariance_share_239m: Positive squared variation divided by total squared variation. It is a second-moment sign allocation and includes the lunch transition, whereas the selected candidate is a centered standardized third moment over the 238 within-half returns.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_return_sign_run_imbalance_238p: Sequential imbalance of same-sign pairs with magnitudes discarded. Skewness ignores ordering and retains signed magnitude asymmetry.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_diffusive_variation_ratio_238m: Adjacent absolute-return products divided by realized variance. It measures path continuity and jump dominance without retaining positive-versus-negative tail asymmetry.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_terminal_close_location_240m: Terminal close location in the intraday close range. It is a path endpoint statistic rather than a distributional third moment.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_realized_volatility: Total return magnitude. Skewness is invariant to a common positive rescaling of all within-day returns and does not measure total variance.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: intraday_return_kurtosis_or_tail_index
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Fourth standardized moment, tail quantile, maximum standardized return, or positive/negative tail-count family
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: These create an unrestricted tail-statistic search and the direction-blind variants overlap the consumed variance-entropy and diffusive-variation mechanisms.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: morning_afternoon_or_late_return_skewness
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Compute skewness on a selected half-session or late-session window
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Window selection would reuse the same higher-moment mechanism after observing a full-session result and overlap existing half-day timing mechanisms.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: upside_downside_or_absolute_return_skewness
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Split signs, use absolute returns, or combine separate positive and negative tail statistics
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Sign splitting overlaps the terminal upside-semivariance and sign-composition branches; absolute-return skewness removes the selected signed mechanism.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: bias_corrected_winsorized_or_rank_skewness
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Fisher finite-sample correction, winsorization, clipping, quantile replacement, or rank-based skew
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: All stock-days have the same 238 observations, so finite-sample correction is a common positive multiplier; the other choices are post-result transform searches.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_return_skewness_238m
selected_candidate.formula: m3 / m2^(3/2), where mean_r = Sum(r_j)/238, m2 = Sum((r_j-mean_r)^2)/238, m3 = Sum((r_j-mean_r)^3)/238, across the 238 within-half adjacent minute log returns
selected_candidate.return_grid: Use 119 adjacent returns inside 09:31-11:30 and 119 inside 13:01-15:00. Exclude the standalone 09:30 row and the 11:30-to-13:01 cross-lunch transition.
selected_candidate.mechanism: Return skewness measures whether close-known intraday price updates have a heavier positive or negative signed tail after centering and variance standardization.
selected_candidate.hypothesis: A high close-known skewness value indicates that unusually large signed price updates were tilted toward informed demand rather than informed supply, which may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.economic_distinction: The candidate is amount-free, order-insensitive, centered, and scale-invariant. It measures signed third-moment asymmetry, not total volatility, variance entropy, half-day variance allocation, adjacent-return continuity, sign runs, terminal location, amount distribution, or amount-return dependence.
